name: Abdul Hamid Dbeibah
role: Prime Minister, Government of National Unity (GNU), Tripoli
quote: We [the National Unity government] will be the last transitional stage in Libya... we are ready to hold elections in accordance with the constitution.

name: Khalifa Haftar
role: Field Marshal, Commander-in-Chief, Libyan National Army (LNA)
quote: Vision 2030 is not an end point, but the start of a more ambitious phase, one that will elevate the armed forces to the highest levels of readiness.

name: Saddam Haftar
role: Deputy Commander, LNA; expected head of new three-person executive presidency
quote: Expressed appreciation for US President Trump's directives to bring peace to Libya, during his June 29, 2026 Washington meeting with Secretary of State Rubio.

name: Osama Hamad
role: Prime Minister, Government of National Stability (GNS), Benghazi
quote: We condemn, in the strongest terms, this treacherous terrorist act. There is no place in Libya for anyone who raises arms against the state, and no cover for anyone who plans, executes, finances, or incites assassination and terrorism crimes.

name: Aguila Saleh
quote: Described the idea of forming a new unified government to oversee elections as 'unrealistic,' proposing instead a seven-member committee to undertake the task.

name: Hanna S. Tetteh
role: UN Special Representative & Head of UNSMIL
quote: We now enter a critical phase: advancing unified institutions and the conditions necessary for inclusive elections.

name: Naji Issa
quote: I apologize for not being able to continue in my duties as Governor of the Central Bank of Libya, without stating the reasons, due to their sensitivity.

name: Mohamed Takala
quote: Rejected Central Bank Governor Naji Issa's resignation on August 17, 2026, directing him to continue performing his duties pending a final decision.

name: Mohamed Bahroun ('Al Far')
role: Commander, Isnad Force / First Support Group, Zawiya
quote: We never desired war, nor did we seek confrontation or bloodshed; for the sanctity of life is paramount, and Libyan blood is precious to us all.

name: Marco Rubio
quote: The US will remain at the forefront of diplomatic efforts to support Libyan unity and create the conditions for a democratically elected government to lead Libya forward.

name: Massad Boulos
role: Senior Adviser for Arab and African Affairs to President Trump
quote: The main goal is to unify the Libyans, unify the land, unify the people, and unify the institutions.

name: Mohamed al-Menfi
quote: The success of any consensus is linked to the clarity of its basis, its jurisdictions, and its applicability, especially when it comes to sovereign institutions like the elections commission.

name: Mohamed Wardago
role: Opposition/rebel leader, critic of the Haftar-Dbeibah pact
quote: Nobody can accept that Haftar and his sons should hold key sovereign positions within the Libyan state.
